Because the documents name different product identities, the prompts use only compatible ordinary scene cues such as office, home, shared-space work, papers, notebooks, and sketchbooks, without merging product-specific claims.

The source messaging provides overlapping mobile professional, meeting, security, and work-anywhere cues, plus sketching and note-taking language, but it names a different product variant. The camera tag is registered and tight, so all prompts are reduced to one support surface, at most one local prop, no background details, and no people.
debug.count_explanation: Generated exactly 20 distinct prompts. The set covers Home, Office, Education, Gaming, Café, and Creative Studio while respecting the tight laptop_BackRightCloseUp camera limits.
ignored_fields: Repeated marketing copy variants and duplicated passages were not treated as additional evidence.
Legal disclaimers, footnotes, authoring instructions, confidentiality language, publication metadata, and contact names were not used as scene instructions.
Technical specifications such as processor, operating system, connectivity, security mechanisms, and privacy features were not converted into visible props.
debug.diversity_summary: The bank varies among corporate office desks, home workspace desks, a living-room end table, café tables, creative office tables, library/classroom study surfaces, and gaming desks. Because the camera profile allows no background detail and only one local prop, diversity is primarily expressed through support surface, setting label, ordinary prop choice, and lighting style.
